query:
WITH args AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM UNNEST(
        $1::UUID[],
        $2::UUID[]
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(dispatch_id, value_slot_id, ord)
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        args.ord,
        args.dispatch_id,
        args.value_slot_id,
        vspd.name AS value_slot_name,
        vk.key AS value_slot_value_kind
    FROM args
    JOIN rev.dispatches d ON d.id = args.dispatch_id
    JOIN rev.value_slots vs ON vs.id = args.value_slot_id
    JOIN rev.versioned_objects vo ON vo.id = vs.versioned_object_id
    JOIN rev.object_paths op ON op.id = vo.path_id
    JOIN rev.value_slot_path_details vspd ON vspd.path_id = op.id
    JOIN rev.value_kinds vk ON vk.id = vs.value_kind_id
),
objs AS (
    INSERT INTO rev.dispatch_intent_bindings (dispatch_id, value_slot_id, created_at)
    SELECT r.dispatch_id, r.value_slot_id, now()
    FROM resolved r
    ORDER BY r.ord
    RETURNING *
),
numbered_objs AS (
    SELECT o.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY o.id) AS ord
    FROM objs o
)
SELECT
    no.id,
    no.dispatch_id,
    no.value_slot_id,
    r.value_slot_name,
    r.value_slot_value_kind,
    no.created_at
FROM numbered_objs no
JOIN resolved r ON r.ord = no.ord
ORDER BY no.id;
